description: Proposed two source candidates (Non-Human Identity Management Group, Security Boulevard) in Batch 7 that had already been designated as passes/rejected. Specifically, Security Boulevard had been rejected in prior batches. Failed to cross-reference the full rejected list in proposed-sources.md before writing new proposals. Also failed to update the watchtower-weekly dashboard artifact despite step-05 explicitly requiring it as non-negotiable.
correction: Source proposals must be cross-checked against ALL entries in proposed-sources.md (pending, approved, AND rejected) before writing. Dashboard artifact must be updated even in non-interactive sessions — if the artifact tools are available, the update is required; log artifact_updated: false only after a genuine attempt fails.
systemic_fix: Before writing any source batch, read proposed-sources.md in full including the Rejected section and build the exclusion set from all three states (pending, approved, rejected). Dashboard update must be attempted before declaring it skipped — ToolSearch for artifact tools is mandatory pre-flight in step-05.
